messages:
maria: Heads-up: found a confusing precedence bug when starting localserve. I ran `redwoodctl localserve --profile staging --port 8080` but telemetry showed requests hitting our prod tenant. Repro steps below.

oliver: that sounds scary. Can you paste the exact env + command and the small log snippet?

maria: sure:
```
$ export REDWOOD_PROFILE=default
$ redwoodctl localserve --profile staging --port 8080
Starting localserve with profile: staging
Loaded credentials from env/config
Serving on http://localhost:8080
[14:34:10] routing: request -> host api.redwood.ai (prod)
[14:34:10] auth: using token for profile default (expires 2026-10-01)
```
So CLI prints "Starting localserve with profile: staging" but the auth layer picks up the REDWOOD_PROFILE token (default). That caused prod calls during my staging tests.

maya: thanks for the repro. Sounds like we evaluate env/config after flag parsing but the auth loader reads REDWOOD_PROFILE unconditionally later and wins. Workaround: `unset REDWOOD_PROFILE` before running or prefix the command: `REDWOOD_PROFILE=staging redwoodctl localserve --profile staging` (but that is confusing).

oliver: agreed this is bad DX. Fix should be: flags override env, and if both are present warn the user about mismatch. Also add a unit test for precedence and update docs. We should also add a runtime warning: if CLI flag and env differ, print `Warning: REDWOOD_PROFILE is set to X, overriding CLI --profile` or the reverse depending on chosen precedence.

maria: filed a small repro gist and included the logs. My suggested fix: 1) make CLI flag highest precedence, 2) if env is set and differs, print a one-line warning, 3) add e2e test. Also add a note in onboarding about recommended usage.

devex-bot: Created issue #1105: "cli: profile precedence bug (REDWOOD_PROFILE vs --profile) causes auth to use wrong token; make flags override env and emit warning"  https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/1105

maya: triage: label=cli, severity=p1 for potential safety leak to prod. I'll pick this up tomorrow; quick patch: check after flag parsing and set the active profile deterministically, then log a warning if mismatch.

maria: thanks  unblocked for local testing once I unset REDWOOD_PROFILE. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
